sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। ७६ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 76 ।।

translations.english: When he of terrible prowess was slain in combat by that bull among monkeys, the earth with its mountains and forests trembled, and fear entered still deeper into the rakshasas.
